verdict.rationale: Kimi is an agentic assistant with a coding CLI, desktop app and IDE agent, so connecting to MCP servers is a fair question for it. However, no item in the evidence pack mentions MCP or connecting external tool servers. The closest items are generic 'plugins and skills' install and publish docs (kimi-docs-13) and ACP editor integration (kimi-docs-5), and neither is documented as MCP client support.
